final: SELECT store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / AVG(SUM(CASE WHEN active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
